subject.title: Gemini 2.5 Pro: textSignature bloat + think tags + mixed text/tool causes session failures

question: Should OpenClaw continue preserving and replaying Google same-model text-part `thoughtSignature`/`textSignature`, or should those signatures be stripped, detached, capped, or otherwise bounded to control Gemini session bloat?
rationale: Current code and tests treat Google signatures as replay-relevant provider state, but the issue shows that preserving valid text signatures can inflate session history and contribute to lost replies, so automation should not choose the provider contract alone.

options.title: Bound signatures without dropping the contract
options.body: Keep Google replay compatibility but move, cap, prune, or detach text-part signatures so they no longer dominate session replay or visible delivery paths.

options.title: Stop replaying text-part signatures
options.body: Strip Google text-part signatures after proving live Gemini multi-turn and tool-call behavior remains correct without them.

options.title: Keep current behavior
options.body: Document the current Google signature retention as an intentional provider tradeoff and route users to provider/workload workarounds.

recommendation.title: Bound signatures without dropping the contract
recommendation.body: Keep Google replay compatibility but move, cap, prune, or detach text-part signatures so they no longer dominate session replay or visible delivery paths.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Google provider signature storage/replay work and latest release provenance point to this owner as the best available decision route.
